messages:
Alex Rivera: Quick postmortem follow-up: recurring GPU pressure Wed afternoons causing autoscale lag + quota errors. Need owners for immediate remediations and short verification.

Alex Rivera: Proposed actions:
```
1) Soft reserve per pool + spill policy -> owner: Nina Park   | RL-3710 | due 2026-04-04
2) Scheduler tuning (queue thresholds) -> owner: Jorge Alvarez | RL-3715 | due 2026-03-31
3) Canary + smoke asserts             -> owner: Anya Sokolov  | RL-3721 | due 2026-03-30
```

Nina Park: taking 1. Plan: reserve min(2 GPUs, 12%) per pool, on-exhaust spill to dedicated warm pool. Will add metrics to dashboard and a small staging run.

Jorge Alvarez: taking 2. I want to tune sched_queue_alert and pod_start_ms SLOs. Will run synthetic bursts and measure 95/99 pct.

Anya Sokolov: taking 3. Canary plan: route 3% traffic for 20m and require 95% < 450ms. Canary command (staging):
```
wrk -t2 -c40 -d20m http://staging/api/v1/generate
```

ops-bot: RL links: https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3710 https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3715 https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3721. Alert prototype: https://monitoring.internal/alerts/auto-scale-proto

Alex Rivera: request: daily 1-line updates on RL tickets. Weekly check-in Fri 16:00 UTC for progress.

Nina Park: will post daily. Staging run planned 2026-03-28.

Jorge Alvarez: will post initial tuning results by 2026-03-30.

Anya Sokolov: canary scheduled 2026-03-29; will abort and rollback on any error spike >2%. Rollback command: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/autoscaler`

Alex Rivera: tagging recurring incidents label `gpu-autoscale-repeat` and linking to RL-3721 for visibility. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
